thread:
sarah: FYI handoff — AcmeCorp VIP load test scheduled tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT. I'm on a flight and will be out of reach after 09:00. Leaving notes & who covers what. TL;DR: potential spike on /generate and embeddings; SLA watch.

mike: Copy. I'll cover the first hour (09:45-11:00 PT) and can handle failover to smaller model variants if latency > 500ms. Any special auth or keys?

sarah: Acme is using dedicated pool D-42. No extra keys; traffic will come from acme-prod-ip range. Watch token burn — they have a strict monthly contract cap. If we exceed, billing team needs to approve.

chen: On monitoring — dashboard link: https://console.redwood/acme/dedicated/D-42
Set an alert for 95p latency > 450ms and token-rate > 120k/min. I put the alert in ops-runbooks.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: @mike assigned for 09:45-11:00 PT. Escalation: @julia if latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive mins.

julia: I'm on standby 10:45-12:30 PT. Can take over if you need to dig into node-level issues. If it's capacity, we can hot-add a shard from the spare pool (procedure below).

mike: Good. What's the hot-add procedure? Share quick commands so I don't fumble.

sarah: Quick steps (from runbook):
```
# add shard to dedicated pool D-42
api call: POST /internal/pools/D-42/scale?add_shards=1
check: GET /internal/pools/D-42/status -> ensure new shard state == READY
if not READY -> rollback: POST /internal/pools/D-42/scale?remove_shards=1
```
You need ops token (ops_bot_creds) — Julia has it.

chen: Also watch KV cache pressure on seq len > 2048. If memory climbs > 78% on any node, prioritize evicting cold prefixes. I left a cache-tune suggestion in the runbook (reduction factor=0.7).

mike: Noted. I'll monitor memory + 95p latency. If we see sustained 95p > 700ms, I'll flip routing to model-quant-2 (lower perf but cheaper) per fallback policy.

julia: If you flip routing, ping me in thread and I'll open a canary rollout to ensure no correctness regression. Also keep an eye on logs for tokenization errors — Acme has a custom tokenizer shim.

sarah: One more contract note: Acme's SLA penalty clause triggers at 99.9% availability for the window. If we foresee risk, escalate to @contracts (billing) early so they can prep comms.

mike: Will do. I'll post an update here at 09:50 PT with initial baseline metrics. If anyone wants to add pre-checks I missed, drop them now. :eyes:

chen: Pre-checks: health-check of ingress LB, warm caches (`/internal/cache/warm?pool=D-42`), and verify that autoscaler max_shards >= expected concurrency. I ran them earlier but good to re-run pre-window.

sarah: Thanks team — leaving the following short checklist in case it's useful to copy: 
- confirm ops creds with Julia
- run cache warm script 09:30 PT
- set alerts (latency, token-rate, memory)
- confirm hot-add steps & spare shards available
- billing notified if we exceed projected token usage

mike: Copy checklist. I'll run warm + set alerts at 09:30 PT. Posting results back here. :thumbsup:

julia: I'll be on pager and can accept escalation. GL team.

oncall-bot: Thread pinned to #eng-oncall.

mike: 09:32 PT — warm script completed, caches at 92% target, alerts live, spare shard count = 2. No immediate red flags. Will update at 09:50 baseline.

sarah: Perfect — thanks everyone, feel calmer leaving you with it. Safe flight. :airplane:
